name: merfisheyes
description: Open your own spatial transcriptomics data in the MERFISHEYES viewer — nothing uploaded — and search the MERFISHEYES catalog.
long_description: Ask Claude to show your data: a SpatialData store, an .h5ad, a Xenium export, a MERSCOPE region or a molecule table on this computer opens in the MERFISHEYES viewer in your browser, served from this computer only. Data that is not a store yet is converted by MERFISHEYES's own pipeline; the first time, Claude asks you before MERFISHEYES downloads its converter (Python and the pipeline's packages, about 1.3 GB, into its own folder — nothing installed system-wide). Claude can also search the public MERFISHEYES catalog, hand you viewer links set up as you ask, and — once you sign in — read your MERFISHEYES projects.

python.title: Python for converting raw data (optional)
python.description: Leave empty: the first time you open raw data, MERFISHEYES asks, then sets up its own converter. Pick a Python only if you already have one with MERFISHEYES's pipeline packages.
